patterns.note: A rigid, uniform grid of square cells dominates the entire page, each acting as a container for a distinct visual element or letter.

Scroll-triggered micro-animations occur independently within each grid cell, transforming or revealing elements as the user scrolls down the page. Examples include a logo shrinking and changing, a line moving across an illustration, and new icons appearing or morphing.
A strong juxtaposition of very large, bold serif letters (e.g., 'J', 'E') as primary visual elements against smaller, clean sans-serif text used for branding or labels.
A minimalist white background serves as a clean canvas, allowing vibrant, illustrative spot colors within each grid cell to stand out.
The entire page functions as a single, continuous interactive grid, eschewing traditional content sections like hero, features, or testimonials in favor of a unified visual experience.

technique_notes: The page uses a CSS Grid or Flexbox layout to establish a perfectly uniform grid of square cells. Each cell contains an SVG illustration or text element. Scroll-triggered animations are applied to individual elements within these cells, using CSS keyframes to animate properties like position, scale, opacity, and SVG path data. These animations are synchronized to the scroll position, revealing or transforming elements as they enter or pass through the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold serif characters (~4-5x body) serve as primary visual anchors, contrasting with smaller, clean sans-serif text for logos or labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with most grid cells being perfect squares, though internal illustrations may feature subtle rounding.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and highly uniform, dictated by the rigid grid structure, creating a dense but organized visual field.

standout: The entire homepage is a dynamic, scroll-driven grid of independent, playful micro-animations and transforming illustrations, functioning as an interactive visual index rather than a conventional marketing layout. It prioritizes engagement and delight through continuous motion and visual discovery.
